faq.q: What is the origin of Cebrail?
faq.a: Cebrail is associated with Arabic. Cebrail is the Turkish form of Arabic جِبْرَائِيل (Jibrāʾīl), the Quranic name of the angel Gabriel.
Yes — the underlying form جِبْرَائِيل is Arabic.
